ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR(
AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(EUSFA_Document_Type__c, "General Document"), ISPICKVAL(EUSFA_Document_Type__c, "Store Specific") ), OR( ISBLANK(EUSFA_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(EUSFA_End_Date__c), EUSFA_End_Date__c < EUSFA_Start_Date__c ) ),
AND( ISPICKVAL(EUSFA_Document_Type__c, "Cycle Priorities"), NOT(ISBLANK(EUSFA_Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(EUSFA_End_Date__c)), EUSFA_End_Date__c < EUSFA_Start_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Start Date and End Date are required, and End Date cannot be earlier than Start Date.
